roi.selection: Fixed across scans/modes/b after inspecting uncorrected b0/b1000 images of all ten scans; no registration. Phantom equivalent radius 47 px, centroid (61.1, 73.2). The Oct 7 centre was (61, 71). Interior excludes the boundary and the edge line; background is an empirical corner noise/artifact reference.

effective_b_model.assumptions: E1 b(b_nominal) = lobes(b) + self + cross(b) for v1.8/v1.81, with lobes = b*f(b) (f piecewise-linear between the 100/1000/6000 knots of 0.9997/0.99647/0.99601), self = table b0 row, cross = c*sqrt(b/1000) (c = 167.45 or 0.25 for +x; sign flipped for -x on v1.8; absent for y; slice direction adds +37.3*sqrt(b/1000) on both). v1.91/v1.911: dev(b)=b_eff-b is fitted as s+alpha*b+beta*sqrt(b) to the four E1 table rows (residual reported by beff_fit_residuals). Echo e adds the b-independent offset (b0 row echo e - echo 1). Slice-direction cross term for v1.911 and y/-x terms for v1.911 are NOT in the report: assumed equal to the +x row / v1.81 value. Delta30 (scan I), 40 kHz readout (J, K) are not modeled: Delta40 / 50 us tables are used.

navigator_limits: Navigator noise floor is the median navigator-window power estimate (samples 16:48, 80:112, /ln2) over volumes with b>=3000 (no signal); amplitude = sqrt(max(L2^2 - 128*floor, 0)). Navigator L2 includes noise; peak centroid is the power-weighted centroid of 5 samples around the maximum.
